project: Heyting Guard Synthesis & Kripke-Joyal CFG Semantics

nodes.informal_claim: In any Heyting algebra, a meet (a => b) <= b.
In any Heyting algebra, if a meet g <= b then g <= (a => b).
By the Heyting adjunction, a meet g <= b iff g <= (a => b).
For any Kripke-Joyal CFG transfer T with GaloisConnection post pullback, T.post (a meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b) <= b.
For any Kripke-Joyal CFG transfer T with GaloisConnection post pullback, if T.post (a meet g) <= b then g <= synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b.
Across two CFG branch transitions T1 and T2, T1.post (a meet g) <= b1 and T2.post (a meet g) <= b2 iff g <= synthesizeEdgeGuard T1 a b1 meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T2 a b2.
Every CFGTransfer T preserves binary meets on pullbacks: T.pullback (b1 meet b2) = T.pullback b1 meet T.pullback b2.
Guard synthesis across a composed path T1.comp T2 equals nested stage-by-stage guard synthesis: synthesizeEdgeGuard (T1.comp T2) a c = synthesizeEdgeGuard T1 a (T2.pullback c).

Synthesizing a guard for a conjunction b1 meet b2 at the target block equals the meet of the synthesized guards: synthesizeEdgeGuard T a (b1 meet b2) = synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b1 meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b2.
Given two converging CFG paths P1, P2 : CFGTransfer alpha gamma, P1.post (a meet g) join P2.post (a meet g) <= c iff g <= synthesizeEdgeGuard P1 a c meet synthesizeEdgeGuard P2 a c.
A predicate inv is a forward loop invariant (L.post inv <= inv) iff it is Kripke-Joyal stable under back-edge pullback (inv <= L.pullback inv).
IsLoopInvariant L inv holds iff the abductive loop-step guard is trivial (synthesizeLoopStepGuard L inv = top).
Conjoining any candidate invariant inv with its abductive loop-step guard guarantees the invariant holds after executing the loop body: L.post (inv meet synthesizeLoopStepGuard L inv) <= inv.
If inv1 and inv2 are both loop invariants for L, their conjunction inv1 meet inv2 is also a loop invariant.
If IsLoopInvariant L inv, then inv is preserved across two back-to-back iterations: (L.comp L).post inv <= inv.
If IsInductiveFor L inv target, conjoining preheader state a0 with hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv establishes target on loop entry: E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv) <= target.
If IsLoopInvariant L inv, conjoining a0 with hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv preserves inv after executing the preheader followed by the loop body: L.post (E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) <= inv.

If IsInductiveFor L inv target, the hoisted preheader guard guarantees target still holds after executing the preheader followed by the loop body: L.post (E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) <= target.
